research.title: Visual Surface Defect Classification with Handcrafted Features
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, standardizing image dimensions, and separating training and evaluation sets by source specimen.
Implemented a prescribed baseline using pooled image gradients and a linear support vector classifier; summarized confusion patterns across defect categories.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed missing item reports to the appropriate staff.
Maintained order paperwork, organized storage areas, and coordinated routine pickup schedules while tracking outstanding requests through completion.

projects.title: Scene Classification with Spatial Color Histograms
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using spatially pooled color histograms and a random forest classifier on labeled indoor and outdoor images.
Compared global and spatial histogram representations under a fixed data split, inspecting misclassified images for lighting variation and similar color distributions.
